title: COL-Trees: Efficient Hierarchical Object Search in Spatial Networks
abstract: arXiv:2601.22183v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Many spatial network applications, such as map-based services, rely heavily on efficient methods to search for relevant nearby points-of-interest (POIs). A $k$ Nearest Neighbor ($k$NN) query is one such example that finds the $k$ closest POIs from an agent's location. While most existing techniques for spatial networks focus on retrieving nearby POIs for a single agent, these search heuristics do not translate to many other applications. For example, Aggregate $k$ Nearest Neighbor (A$k$NN) queries require POIs that are close to multiple agents. $k$ Farthest Neighbors ($k$FN) queries require POIs that are the antithesis of nearest. Such problems naturally benefit from a hierarchical approach, but existing methods rely on Euclidean-based heuristics, which have diminished effectiveness in spatial networks such as road network graphs. We propose a novel data structure, COL-Tree (Compacted Object-Landmark Tree), to address this gap

translated_title: COL-Trees：空间网络中高效的层次化对象搜索
translated_abstract: 许多空间网络应用，例如基于地图的服务，严重依赖于高效的方法来搜索附近相关的兴趣点（POI）。k近邻查询就是这样一个例子，它从代理的位置找到k个最近的兴趣点。虽然现有的空间网络技术大多集中于为单个代理检索附近的兴趣点，但这些搜索启发式方法并不能推广到许多其他应用。例如，聚合k近邻查询需要找到接近多个代理的兴趣点，k最远邻居查询则需要找到与最近邻相对的最远兴趣点。这些问题天然适合采用层次化的方法，但现有方法依赖于基于欧几里得距离的启发式策略，而这类策略在道路网络图等空间网络中有效性会显著下降。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了一种新颖的数据结构——COL-Tree（压缩对象-地标树，Compacted Object-Landmark Tree）。
tldr: 提出了一种新颖的数据结构COL-Tree，通过层次化方法高效解决空间网络中聚合k近邻查询和k最远邻查询等复杂对象搜索问题，弥补了现有基于欧几里得距离启发式方法在空间网络中失效的不足。
en_tdlr: Proposes a novel data structure, COL-Tree (Compacted Object-Landmark Tree), to efficiently support hierarchical object search in spatial networks for complex queries like Aggregate kNN and k Farthest Neighbors, overcoming the limitations of Euclidean-based heuristics.
